# thetalake_identity (Data Source)

The identity data source enables lookup of identity IDs by email address.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "thetalake_identity" "example" {
  email = "user@example.com"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `email` (String) The email address of the identity to look up

### Read-Only

- `external_id` (String) The external ID of the identity
- `id` (Number) The identity ID
- `name` (String) The name of the identity
